Hi! I am in a situation where I needed to implement CTL logic that combines routine Temporal modality, and Alethic-Temporal. See chapter 8 of this pdf. This gave me: EF p "possibly p", AF p "eventually p", AG p "necessarily p", and EG p. I ran into this when I was trying to combine state machines of TLA to get multi-modality. In order to do security proofs like Kerberos, I needed knowledge modality and permission modality.

I am implementing my formal methods system in Lean, as it dramatically simplified a lot of the issue I had. Instead of modelling state like TLA+ does, I avoid state entirely by simply modelling a contect-sensitive grammar of all logical byte (ie: protobuf) movement per scenario. I do this via a Context-Free-Grammar, with CTL on where clauses.

I suspect that I should be using CSLib, but I currently do not know enough about it to use it. So, I am using Lean as a Functional programming language, and use the fact that it has a TCP socket to implement an http server. I have implemented both agents that use the tools (ie: to write the book, write requirements, or one-shot code), or to use my custom chat UI; that is designed around "communicating in diagarams".

https://rfielding.github.io/leanFM-dark.pdf
